name: El Rourell (Spain)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with a yellow fruited eradicated oak.
history: The official flag of El Rourell is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, light blue, with the yellow fruited eradicated oak of the arms, 7/12 of the height and 2/7 of the length of the cloth, at the centre; approved on 26 March 2019 and published in the DOGC on 29 March 2019.
